en: Bima and Ibu lie on a mat under the mango tree. They look up at the sky.
A big white cloud floats by. 'It looks like an elephant!' says Bima.
The wind blows softly. The elephant stretches out. Now it looks like a long fish.
A little cloud looks like a boat. 'Sail away, little boat!' says Ibu.
Grey clouds come. Pitter-patter! Rain is falling. Time to go inside.
id: Bima dan Ibu berbaring di tikar di bawah pohon mangga. Mereka memandang langit.
Awan putih besar melayang. 'Seperti gajah!' kata Bima.
Angin bertiup pelan. Gajahnya memanjang. Sekarang seperti ikan yang panjang.
Awan kecil seperti perahu. 'Berlayarlah, perahu kecil!' kata Ibu.
Awan kelabu datang. Tik, tik, tik! Hujan turun. Saatnya masuk ke rumah.

readAloudNotes.en: Lie back or lean back and point upwards together.
readAloudNotes.id: Bersandar atau berbaring dan tunjuk ke atas bersama.

readAloudNotes.en: Swing your arm like an elephant's trunk.
Blow softly on your child's hand, then wiggle your hand like a fish.
readAloudNotes.id: Tiup pelan tangan anak, lalu goyangkan tangan seperti ikan.

readAloudNotes.en: Rock your hands side to side like a little boat.
readAloudNotes.id: Goyangkan tangan ke kiri dan kanan seperti perahu kecil.

readAloudNotes.en: Tap your fingertips gently on your child's arm like rain.
readAloudNotes.id: Ketuk ujung jari pelan di lengan anak seperti hujan.

sequenceCards.en: Card 1: a mother and child on a mat under a tree
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 1: ibu dan anak di tikar di bawah pohon
Kartu 5: awan kelabu dan tetes hujan

objectives.en: Listens to a story and describes simple shapes seen in clouds.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita dan menyebut bentuk sederhana pada awan.

objectives.en: Notices that wind moves clouds and grey clouds can bring rain.
objectives.id: Menyadari bahwa angin menggerakkan awan dan awan kelabu bisa membawa hujan.

meaning.en: a white or grey shape floating in the sky
meaning.id: bentuk putih atau kelabu yang melayang di langit

meaning.en: a colour between black and white

prompt.en: What did the first cloud look like?
Why did the elephant cloud change into a fish?
prompt.id: Mengapa awan gajah berubah menjadi ikan?

en: the wind moved and stretched it

prompt.en: What happened when the grey clouds came?
prompt.id: Apa yang terjadi saat awan kelabu datang?

en: it rained and they went inside
a boat sailed on the river
id: hujan turun dan mereka masuk ke rumah

connection.en: Wind moves and changes clouds; dark grey clouds often bring rain.
connection.id: Angin menggerakkan dan mengubah bentuk awan; awan kelabu gelap sering membawa hujan.

connection.en: Seeing pictures in clouds grows imagination and describing words.
connection.id: Melihat gambar pada awan mengembangkan imajinasi dan kata-kata untuk menggambarkan.

discussionPrompts.en: What shape would you like to see in a cloud?
discussionPrompts.id: Bentuk apa yang ingin kamu lihat di awan?

discussionPrompts.en: What do grey clouds tell us?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa arti awan kelabu bagi kita?

offlineActivity.en: On a cloudy day, lie on a mat in the shade with your child and take turns saying what each cloud looks like. Never look straight at the sun.
offlineActivity.id: Saat langit berawan, berbaringlah di tikar di tempat teduh bersama anak dan bergantian menyebut bentuk setiap awan. Jangan pernah menatap matahari langsung.

factChecks.claim: Wind moves clouds and changes their shape.
Dark grey clouds often bring rain.

safetyNotes.en: Cloud-watch in the shade and remind your child never to look straight at the sun. Go indoors if you hear thunder.
safetyNotes.id: Amati awan di tempat teduh dan ingatkan anak jangan menatap matahari langsung. Masuklah ke rumah jika terdengar guntur.

safetyNotes.en: Choose shade away from fruit trees in fruiting season and from ant trails.
safetyNotes.id: Pilih tempat teduh yang jauh dari pohon yang sedang berbuah dan dari jalur semut.
